name: Framework7 Icons
about: Framework7 Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 1,253 icons designed by Vladimir Kharlampidi. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Framework7 Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,253 Framework7 Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Framework7 Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Framework7 Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,253 icons in the Framework7 Icons set, designed by Vladimir Kharlampidi. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Framework7 Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Framework7 Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
